conventions.marks: What each call proves, for scripts/hardening_status.py mark … --live --model marks-model once the answers are read: dialog_answer (call 1: live_run step 3 types into the Note prompt and presses OK; its checks read result.typed.text and the person's note back), gui_unstick (call 2: the prompt is left open by step 2 and live_run's end closes it with gui_unstick { all: true }, the tool itself, said in leftOpen), snapshot_list (calls 4 to 6: the camera button's own command, AgentLink_Shot, records a shot; snapshot_list lists it and snapshot_latest shows it), addon_test (calls 7 to 10: a real run of one test file in a separate FreeCAD process). queue_go: not marked unattended — see needsPerson.

needsPerson.why: queue_go is the person's go for heavy jobs held while they work in the window, and the tool's own rule is to call it only on their word in chat, never by an agent's choice. The held state cannot be made unattended either: the supervisor holds new heavy jobs only while a heavy job runs and macOS reports the person's own mouse or keyboard input in the last moments (keep.person_idle_seconds reads IOHIDSystem's HIDIdleTime; gui_input's Qt events are not HID input). So the mark needs the person: they work in the window while a heavy job runs, then say go in chat. The calls below are the runner's part, one at a time (direct), only then.

calls.expect: Agent Link's whole test suite starts in a separate FreeCAD process (heavy: a job that runs for minutes): job, state running. Meanwhile the person clicks or types in FreeCAD's window for a few seconds
queue.held: 'A heavy job is running (addon_test, since …); new heavy jobs wait for your go' — set by the supervisor once the person used the window while the job ran
ONLY AFTER THE PERSON SAYS GO IN CHAT: go true, wasHeld true, running lists what still runs (addon_test while the suite still runs), machine { heavySlots, memoryCeilingGB, fan }
the suite's counts; call again while state is running (failed 0 expected)
